The '''Tribal Settlement Cave''' was a cave located in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was inhabited by the [[Sons of Palawa]].<ref name="TOR:TGotD" />
